name: Bridon American Corporation
old_description: Bexco® Synthetic Ropes by Bekaert is a leading European manufacturer of precision-engineered synthetic mooring, towing and lifting ropes for offshore, marine and industrial applications.
about:
Bridon American Corporation operates from Exeter, Pennsylvania, as the U.S. arm of Bekaert's rope division. Bekaert, a global leader in steel wire transformation and coating technologies, traces its rope-making heritage back more than 300 years, while the modern corporation builds on over 140 years of innovation in materials and manufacturing. The business brings together centuries of rope-making expertise with Bekaert's strengths in technology and innovation to serve mission-critical applications worldwide.

The company manufactures precision-engineered steel wire ropes and synthetic ropes under the Bridon® and Bexco® brands. Its product portfolio covers mooring, towing, lifting, and hauling ropes for heavy-duty use. Beyond manufacturing, Bridon American provides Ropes360® services, including installation of reels up to 450 metric tons with on-site splicing and socketing, visual and advanced non-destructive inspections, forensic laboratory testing of new and retired ropes, repair and maintenance such as re-lubrication and re-socketing, training, and custom design with tailored logistics and consignment stocking.

Customers span renewable energy, oil and gas, mining, cranes and industrial, and commercial fishing. In renewable energy, the ropes are used on wind turbine installation vessels. Oil and gas clients rely on them for offshore drilling, marine riser tensioners, and offshore lifting. Mining operations use shovel ropes, dragline ropes, and drum winder ropes. Crane applications include offshore cranes, telescopic mobile cranes, and industrial hoist ropes. Commercial fishing fleets employ trawl warps and purse wires.

Bekaert positions its rope business around four legacy strengths: heritage in mission-critical rope manufacturing, technology leadership and innovation, deep understanding of market needs, and global presence with local expertise. The company emphasizes a "better together" approach, co-creating solutions with customers to extend rope life, maximize safety, and reduce downtime through integrated inspection, testing, and maintenance services.
